name: Financial Modeling
description: Build live financial models through MCP tools: trend and growth forecasts written as sheet formulas, NPV/IRR valuation over a cash-flow column, and what-if scenario sweeps that drive the sheet's own formulas.

prompts.name: project-revenue
prompts.title: Project revenue for the next 6 periods
prompts.text: In the "Model" sheet, use fin_forecast to project the Revenue column 6 periods ahead with the linear method, then read back the forecast rows and summarize the trend (slope per period and the final projected value).

prompts.name: value-this-project
prompts.title: Value a project from its cash flows
prompts.text: The "Project" sheet has a CashFlow column and an initial investment of 10000. Use fin_npv_irr at a 10% discount rate to compute NPV and IRR, and tell me whether the project clears a 12% hurdle rate.

prompts.name: stress-test-price
prompts.title: Stress-test the price input
prompts.text: In the "Pricing" sheet the unit price is in B2 and profit is computed in B10. Use fin_scenario_sweep to vary B2 over 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 and show me the profit at each price.
